Description: Acceptance criteria: Permitted use, consent, retention and a human decision owner are defined and documented.
Acceptance criteria: User selects the language; JPG/PNG files up to 10 MB and 40 MP are accepted; other files are rejected with a clear message.

Summary: US03 OCR in the original language
Description: Acceptance criteria: OCR runs in the selected original language and reaches 99.5-100% character accuracy on ten synthetic scans.
Acceptance criteria: Text must be 200-2000 words and at most 100,000 characters; otherwise the user sees a clear error.

Summary: US05 Edit OCR output, cancel and retry
Description: Acceptance criteria: User can edit OCR text and cancel and retry a scan; the Analyze button is enabled again after cancel/retry.
Acceptance criteria: Russian evaluation can be rerun with fixed inputs and reproduces the recorded results.
Acceptance criteria: Kazakh evaluation limits are documented and claims are restricted to what was tested.
Acceptance criteria: Browser and model results match on the 58 parity cases.
Acceptance criteria: Index uses the 25 and 70 thresholds and shows an uncertain state; the number is not presented as an authorship probability.
Acceptance criteria: Frozen splits and reused legacy tests are recorded, and topic-overlap risk is stated.
Acceptance criteria: Workflow is usable at screen widths from 320 to 1440 px.
Acceptance criteria: PDF report contains extractable Cyrillic and Kazakh text.
Acceptance criteria: Highlighted passages are worded as review guidance, never as a finding about a sentence.

Summary: US14 User pilot with five volunteers
Description: Acceptance criteria: Pilot sessions with five volunteers are held and results are reported honestly, including unmet targets.
Acceptance criteria: Pilot defects are ranked by risk, each with an owner.
Acceptance criteria: Model and data records are documented and linked from the repository.
Acceptance criteria: Loading and processing times are measured and recorded.
Acceptance criteria: The app is reachable at a stable HTTPS address and passes three-language smoke checks.
Acceptance criteria: Guide covers photo guidance and limits, labels timing targets as unmeasured and promises no speed.
Acceptance criteria: Release checklist is completed, including smoke checks and a rollback rehearsal.
